description: This file defines the Credentials class in the Aws\Credentials namespace, implementing AWS credential handling including access key, secret key, token, expiration, and serialization.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: Implements AWS credential storage including keys, tokens, expiration, and serialization features.

methods.name: __construct
